links.outcome: Reproducibility of chatbot response quality across six repeated weekly rounds
links.effect: No significant variation across six rounds for ChatGPT-5 (p = 0.106) or Gemini 2.5 Pro (p = 0.128); low Kendall's W indicated high short-term stability.
links.quote: Temporal consistency analysis showed no significant variation across six rounds for either ChatGPT-5 (p = 0.106) or Gemini 2.5 Pro 2.5 Pro (p = 0.128), with low Kendall’s W values indicating high short-term stability.

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (Ateşman score, higher is easier) for patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 scored 83.43 vs Gemini 2.5 Pro 71.86 (p < 0.001), so ChatGPT-5 responses were significantly more readable.
links.quote: Readability analysis demonstrated that ChatGPT-5 produced significantly more readable responses than Gemini 2.5 Pro 2.5 Pro, with higher Ateşman readability scores (83.43 vs. 71.86, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (validity, readability, temporal consistency) in answering patient FAQs in oral surgery across multiple time points, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
